---
name: Proposal
about: Propose a bounded claim/evidence capability or public-surface improvement
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Problem or user outcome
Describe the concrete need without strengthening evidence semantics by implication.

## Proposed contract
Define inputs, outputs, states, failure behavior, compatibility, and the smallest intended scope.

## Current evidence and alternatives
Separate implementation facts, active contract semantics, external methods, and hypotheses.

## Affected surfaces
List implementation, `MANIFEST.yaml`, active contracts, current documents, metadata, or maintenance surfaces that require synchronization.

## Acceptance criteria
State deterministic or observable review criteria relevant to the proposal.

## Non-goals and semantic risks
State what the proposal must not imply about truth, confidence, credibility, source authority, or scientific validity.
